title: AutoMount
description: Automatically load entities into boats and minecarts with a single click.
body:
AutoMount
Automatically load entities into boats and minecarts with a simple click.
Features:
Shift+Right Click any entity with the Loader Stick to select it
Shift+Right Click a boat or minecart to load the selected entity inside
Single mode — select one entity at a time
Multi mode — select multiple entities, load them into different vehicles
Press N to toggle between Single and Multi mode
Crafting:
![H](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0407e6e6c82c689313f0537b26420a83aa89c829.jpeg)
Requires: 2x Iron Ingot, 3x Chain, 2x Stick
Compatibility: Forge 1.20.1
